PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(./gradlew bootRun|gradle bootRun|./mvnw spring-boot:run|mvn spring-boot:run)"

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')

# Block dev servers that aren't run in tmux
echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: Spring Boot dev server must run in tmux for log access' >&2
echo '[Hook] Use this command instead:' >&2
echo "[Hook] tmux new-session -d -s dev './gradlew bootRun'" >&2
echo '[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev' >&2
exit 1

PreToolUse.description: Block Spring Boot dev servers outside tmux - ensures you can access logs

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then
  echo '[Hook] Consider running in tmux for session persistence' >&2
  echo '[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev' >&2
fi
echo "$input"

PreToolUse.description: Reminder to use tmux for long-running Gradle/Maven commands

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Open editor for review before pushing

# Uncomment your preferred editor:
# idea . 2>/dev/null
# code . 2>/dev/null
# cursor . 2>/dev/null

PreToolUse.description: Pause before git push to review changes

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Block creation of unnecessary documentation files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')

if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(md|txt)$ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ (README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING)\.md$ ]]; then
  echo "[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file creation" >&2
  echo "[Hook] File: $file_path" >&2
  echo "[Hook] Use README.md for documentation instead" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "$input"

PreToolUse.description: Block creation of random .md files - keeps docs consolidated
Suggest manual compaction at logical intervals

SessionStart.description: Load previous context on new session

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-detect PR creation and log useful info
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command')

if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh pr create'; then
  output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.output // ""')
  pr_url=$(echo "$output" | grep -oE 'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/[0-9]+')
  
  if [ -n "$pr_url" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] PR created: $pr_url" >&2
    echo "[Hook] Checking GitHub Actions status..." >&2
    repo=$(echo "$pr_url" | sed -E 's|https://github.com/([^/]+/[^/]+)/pull/[0-9]+|\1|')
    pr_num=$(echo "$pr_url" | sed -E 's|.*/pull/([0-9]+)|\1|')
    echo "[Hook] To review PR: gh pr review $pr_num --repo $repo" >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL and provide review command after PR creation

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-format with ktlint after editing Kotlin files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')

if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  # Try ktlint if available
  if command -v ktlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ktlint -F "$file_path" 2>&1 | head -5 >&2 || true
  # Or try via gradle if in a gradle project
  elif [ -f "./gradlew" ]; then
    echo '[Hook] Consider running: ./gradlew ktlintFormat' >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format Kotlin files with ktlint after edits

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Run Kotlin compile check after editing .kt files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')

if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  dir=$(dirname "$file_path")
  project_root="$dir"
  while [ "$project_root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$project_root/build.gradle.kts" ] && [ ! -f "$project_root/build.gradle" ]; do
    project_root=$(dirname "$project_root")
  done
  
  if [ -f "$project_root/gradlew" ]; then
    echo '[Hook] Kotlin file changed. Run ./gradlew compileKotlin to check for errors' >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

PostToolUse.description: Kotlin compile check reminder after editing .kt files

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Warn about println in edited Kotlin files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')

if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  debug_statements=$(grep -n "println\|System\.out\.print" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  
  if [ -n "$debug_statements" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: println/System.out found in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$debug_statements" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Use logger instead (e.g., LoggerFactory.getLogger)" >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

PostToolUse.description: Warn about println statements - use proper logging instead

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Warn about sensitive data in Spring config files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')

if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  sensitive=$(grep -niE "password:|secret:|api-key:|token:|credentials:" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\${' || true)
  
  if [ -n "$sensitive" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: Potential hardcoded secrets in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$sensitive" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Use environment variables: \${SECRET_NAME} or \${SECRET_NAME:default}" >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

PostToolUse.description: Warn about hardcoded secrets in application.yml

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Report build results
input=$(cat)
output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.output // ""')
exit_code=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.exit_code // 0')

if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo '[Hook] Build successful!' >&2
  # Check for generated artifacts
  if [ -d "build/libs" ]; then
    echo '[Hook] Artifacts in build/libs:' >&2
    ls -la build/libs/*.jar 2>/dev/null | head -3 >&2 || true
  fi
else
  echo '[Hook] Build failed. Check output for errors.' >&2
fi

echo "$input"

PostToolUse.description: Report Gradle build results and artifacts

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Final check for debug statements in modified Kotlin files
input=$(cat)

if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  modified_files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(kt|kts)$' || true)
  
  if [ -n "$modified_files" ]; then
    has_debug=false
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        if grep -qE "println|System\.out\.print" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "[Hook] WARNING: Debug output found in $file" >&2
          has_debug=true
        fi
      fi
    done <<< "$modified_files"
    
    if [ "$has_debug" = true ]; then
      echo "[Hook] Replace println with proper logger before committing" >&2
    fi
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

Stop.description: Final audit for debug statements in modified Kotlin files
